title: Spain Begins Three Days of Mourning After Deadly Train Collision
subtitle: As rescue teams finish searching the wreckage, the government promises a full investigation into the country's latest rail disaster.

summary.en: Spain has entered a period of national mourning following a high-speed train collision that killed at least 69 people. The accident occurred when one train hit another that had stopped on the tracks in the Castilla-La Mancha region. Authorities are now working to identify victims and find the cause of the disaster. While officials suggest human error might be responsible, train drivers are calling for better safety investment. This is the deadliest rail accident in Spain since 2013.
summary.zh: 西班牙在發生一起造成至少六十九人死亡的高速列車相撞事故後，進入全國哀悼期。事故發生時，一列火車撞上了停在卡斯提亞-拉曼查地區軌道上的另一列火車。當局目前正努力辨識罹難者身分並釐清災難原因。雖然官員暗示可能是人為疏失，但火車駕駛員呼籲應增加安全投資。這是西班牙自二〇一三年以來最嚴重的鐵路事故。

paragraphs.en: Spain began three days of mourning on Thursday for the victims of a major high-speed train collision. At least 69 people died in the accident, which took place on Wednesday morning in the central region of Castilla-La Mancha. As hospitals continue to treat dozens of injured passengers, the nation is struggling to understand how such a tragedy could happen on its modern rail network.
paragraphs.zh: 西班牙週四開始為一場重大高速列車相撞事故的罹難者進行為期三天的哀悼。這起事故發生在週三上午，地點位於中部的卡斯提亞-拉曼查地區，造成至少六十九人死亡。隨著醫院持續治療數十名受傷乘客，全國上下正努力釐清這場悲劇為何會發生在現代化的鐵路網上。

paragraphs.en: The accident involved two trains traveling from Madrid toward the southern region of Andalucía. According to The Guardian, one train—operated by the private company Iryo—stopped on the tracks. Shortly after, a second train, operated by the state-owned company Renfe, crashed into the back of the stationary train. The force of the impact caused several carriages to leave the tracks near the town of Urda. Emergency workers spent the night searching the wreckage with cranes and drones to find victims.
paragraphs.zh: 這起事故涉及兩列從馬德里開往南部安達魯西亞地區的列車。根據《衛報》報導，一列由私人公司 Iryo 營運的列車停在軌道上，隨後，一列由國營公司西班牙國家鐵路（Renfe）營運的列車撞上了這列靜止的火車。撞擊力道導致數節車廂在烏爾達鎮附近脫軌。救難人員徹夜使用起重機和無人機搜尋殘骸，以尋找罹難者。

paragraphs.en: This disaster has raised serious concerns about safety standards in Spain. The transport minister, Óscar Puente, stated that rear-end collisions are extremely rare. He suggested that the accident might have been caused by human error, though he described the circumstances as "inexplicable." This is not the first time such an event has occurred; just 10 months ago, a similar collision between Renfe and Iryo trains took place on the same line near the town of Adamuz, resulting in 46 deaths.
paragraphs.zh: 這場災難引發了對西班牙鐵路安全標準的嚴重擔憂。交通部長普恩特（Óscar Puente）表示，追撞事故極為罕見。他暗示事故可能是人為疏失所致，儘管他形容當時的情況「令人費解」。這並非此類事件首次發生；就在十個月前，同一條路線在阿達穆斯鎮附近也發生過類似的 Renfe 與 Iryo 列車相撞事故，造成四十六人死亡。

paragraphs.en: The impact of the crash has reached far beyond Spain. The foreign ministry reported that 42 citizens from seven different countries were involved in the accident. Sadly, one foreign citizen was killed, and at least seven others were injured. Emiliano García-Page, the leader of the regional government, confirmed that 50 people remain in hospitals. While rescue teams do not expect to find more survivors, they are still working to identify body parts found at the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 這場撞擊事故的影響遠超西班牙國界。外交部報告指出，有來自七個不同國家的四十二名公民捲入事故。遺憾的是，有一名外籍人士喪生，另有至少七人受傷。區域政府首長賈西亞-帕格（Emiliano García-Page）證實，目前仍有五十人留院治療。雖然搜救隊預計不會再發現生還者，但他們仍在努力辨識在現場發現的遺體殘骸。

paragraphs.en: In response to the tragedy, Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez visited the emergency command center in Toledo. He promised that the government would work "day and night" to uncover every detail of the crash. He emphasized that the state is committed to strengthening safety measures to ensure that a similar tragedy never happens again. King Felipe also visited a hospital to meet with the injured. He noted that the country has suffered a "harsh blow" and agreed that a full investigation is necessary to learn from this event.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這場悲劇，總理桑傑士（Pedro Sánchez）前往托雷多的緊急指揮中心視察。他承諾政府將「日以繼夜」地工作，以查明事故的每一個細節。他強調，國家致力於加強安全措施，確保類似悲劇不再發生。國王菲利佩（King Felipe）也前往醫院探視傷者。他指出國家遭受了「沉重打擊」，並同意必須進行全面調查，以從此次事件中汲取教訓。

paragraphs.en: Despite the government's focus on the investigation, the accident has sparked tension regarding railway safety. On the same day the mourning period began, train drivers went ahead with a planned strike. They are using this action to demand more investment in the rail system. Diego Martín, a representative for the drivers, stated that the sector must have all the necessary safety systems to maintain the quality standards that Spain has always had. The drivers argue that these investments are essential to prevent future accidents.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管政府將重心放在調查上，這起事故仍引發了關於鐵路安全的緊張局勢。在哀悼期開始的同一天，火車駕駛員仍按計畫發動罷工。他們藉此行動要求對鐵路系統進行更多投資。駕駛員代表馬丁（Diego Martín）表示，該產業必須具備所有必要的安全系統，以維持西班牙一貫的高品質標準。駕駛員認為，這些投資對於防止未來發生事故至關重要。

paragraphs.en: This tragedy is the deadliest rail accident in Europe since 2013, when a derailment in Santiago de Compostela killed 80 people. As the investigation continues, the focus remains on finding out exactly why the Iryo train stopped and why the Renfe train was unable to avoid the collision. For now, the people of Spain are focused on supporting the families of the victims and waiting for answers from the authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 這是自二〇一三年聖地牙哥-德孔波斯特拉發生脫軌事故造成八十人死亡以來，歐洲最嚴重的鐵路事故。隨著調查持續進行，焦點仍集中在釐清 Iryo 列車為何停駛，以及為何 Renfe 列車無法避免碰撞。目前，西班牙民眾正專注於支持罹難者家屬，並等待當局的調查結果。

paragraphs.en: The process of identifying the victims and cleaning up the crash site is expected to take time. Officials have promised transparency, but for many, the focus is on the urgent need for change. With two major accidents on the same line in less than a year, the pressure on the government to prove that the rail network is safe is higher than ever. As the mourning period continues, the nation waits to see what specific safety improvements will be announced to prevent another disaster.
paragraphs.zh: 辨識罹難者身分與清理事故現場的工作預計需要一段時間。官員已承諾保持透明，但對許多人而言，重點在於迫切的改革需求。由於不到一年內在同一條路線上發生了兩起重大事故，政府面臨證明鐵路網安全的壓力比以往任何時候都大。隨著哀悼期持續，全國都在等待政府宣布具體的安全改善措施，以防止另一場災難發生。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cause something to be considered or discussed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「舉起」，這裡指提出問題。文中：This disaster has raised serious concerns about safety standards in Spain.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A sudden event that causes sadness, disappointment, or damage.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「吹氣」，這裡指負面事件帶來的打擊。文中：He noted that the country has suffered a "harsh blow" and agreed that a full investigation is necessary to learn from this event.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To proceed or continue with a planned action despite difficulties or opposition.
keyTerms.noteZh: 非字面意思，指不顧情況繼續執行計畫。文中：On the same day the mourning period began, train drivers went ahead with a planned strike.

quiz.question: According to the report, what specific circumstance regarding the collision was highlighted by the transport minister?

options.A: The collision occurred during a period of heavy rainfall and poor visibility.
options.B: The incident involved two trains from the same company traveling on the same line.
options.C: Rear-end collisions of this nature are considered highly unusual occurrences.
options.D: The train drivers had been on strike at the exact moment the crash happened.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，交通部長 Óscar Puente 明確指出這類追撞事故（rear-end collisions）極為罕見（extremely rare）。選項 A 文章未提及天氣狀況；選項 B 錯誤，因為文章第二段指出事故涉及兩家不同公司（Iryo 與 Renfe）；選項 D 錯誤，因為罷工是在哀悼期開始當天進行，而非事故發生當下。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the state of Spain's railway safety based on the provided text?

options.A: The government has successfully maintained a perfect safety record for over a decade.
options.B: Recent accidents suggest that there may be recurring, unresolved issues on specific rail lines.
options.C: The train drivers are primarily responsible for the lack of investment in the rail system.
options.D: The rail network is currently being managed exclusively by private companies without state oversight.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段提到十個月前在同一條路線發生過類似事故，且第八段強調「在不到一年內發生兩起重大事故」，這暗示了該路線存在持續性的安全隱憂。選項 A 與事實不符；選項 C 錯誤，因為司機是要求政府增加投資，而非責任歸屬；選項 D 錯誤，因為 Renfe 是國營企業，且政府正積極介入調查與改善。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the phrase 'harsh blow' mean in the context of King Felipe's statement?

options.A: A physical attack against the royal family.
options.B: A sudden and severe emotional or national tragedy.
options.C: A strong criticism from the public regarding government policy.
options.D: A technical failure that caused the train to stop abruptly.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「harsh blow」是一個隱喻用法，形容這場災難對國家造成了沉重的打擊與悲痛。選項 A 是對詞彙的字面誤讀；選項 C 雖然文章提到有緊張局勢，但國王此話是指對國家整體的傷害；選項 D 則完全偏離了該詞彙在描述災難影響時的語意。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To provide a detailed technical analysis of how high-speed trains function.
options.B: To highlight the political conflict between the transport minister and the train drivers.
options.C: To report on a tragic train accident and the resulting concerns over railway safety in Spain.
options.D: To compare the safety standards of Spanish rail networks with those of other European countries.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文主要報導了西班牙發生的重大火車相撞事故，並探討了該事件引發的傷亡、政府的調查承諾以及公眾對於鐵路安全標準的質疑。選項 A 過於細節且文章未深入技術層面；選項 B 僅是文中提到的部分背景，非核心主題；選項 D 文章並未與其他歐洲國家進行比較，僅提到該事故是歐洲自 2013 年以來最嚴重的事故。
